blocks.title: CIO Toolkit executive briefing
blocks.note: Demonstration pack. Every number and source in this draft is illustrative. No live enterprise data or AI service is connected.

sections.heading: Executive assessment
paragraphs: Release R-214 in week 9 affected reliability, cost, delivery and security. Payments has used {{K16:paymentsBudgetUsed}} of its error budget. MTTR peaked at {{K17:mttr:at(8)}} and is back to {{K17:mttr:last}}. Cloud cost rose {{K07:spikeW9}} ({{K07:spikeAmt}}) in week 9 and is still {{K07:vsW8}} above week 8.

At the current run-rate the year lands at {{K06:landing}} against a plan of {{K06:fullYearPlan}} ({{K06:landingVsPlan}}). Year-to-date spend is {{K06:budgetYtd}} against plan ({{K06:ytdActual}} against {{K06:ytdBudget}}).

sections.heading: Operations and service
paragraphs: {{K16:overBudget}} critical services are over their error budget. Payments availability is {{K16:paymentsAvailability}} against a {{K16:target}} target. P1 and P2 incidents in week 12: {{K17:incidents:last}}.

sections.heading: Value and financial discipline
paragraphs: Renewals due in the next 6 to 12 months: {{K09:renewals}}. The Observability platform (notice by 15 Nov 2026) and ERP licences (notice by 20 Dec 2026) both carry price uplifts of 7% or more. Cloud waste is {{K07:wasteShare}} of spend and needs FinOps validation before action.

sections.heading: Security and delivery
paragraphs: {{K20:criticalOpen}} critical vulnerabilities are open and {{K20:patchedInSla}} were patched within SLA against a {{K20:patchTarget}} target. {{K24:overdue}} audit findings are overdue ({{K24:high}} high, {{K24:medium}} medium).
{{K14:flagged}} of {{K14:total}} projects are reported Green but show risk signals. The change fail rate on the Payments platform is {{X01:changeFailRate}}.

sections.heading: AI
paragraphs: LLM spend reached {{K35:llmSpendWeekly:last}} last week, or {{K35:annualised}} a year at that rate. Measured benefit is {{K32:measuredValue}} a year, with another {{K32:estimatedValue}} estimated. {{K32:measuredBenefit}} live use cases are measured against a baseline.

sections.heading: Trust and open issues
paragraphs: All figures are illustrative and have not come from connected sources. The year-end landing is a trend-based forecast, not an approved one. The change fail rate (X01) is a proposed KPI that is not yet in the KPI catalogue. Approval: pending CIO and Finance review.
